title: R12 NineT Roadster (Apex Spec)
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's engineering ethos in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the BMW Motorrad R12 NineT Roadster (Apex Spec) is born on the race grid to deliver uncompromised high-speed aerodynamic downforce. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. An aggressive Aggressive Forward Tuck layout places rider weight decisively over the front axle with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, maximizing cornering feedback at apex speeds.
